A group of '''tomb raiders''' was active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] around the<ref name="Tomb Raiders" /> [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The group clashed with the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and was led by an [[Unidentified criminal (Korriban tomb raiders)|eccentric underworld figure]].<ref name="Tomb Raiders" /> Eventually, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Rikel (Imperial Army)|Rikel]] of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] issued [[Imperial Edict 936]], although the forces [[Gender/Legends|he]] sent to recover stolen artifacts and eliminate the looters in the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Imperial Edict">{{TORcite|type=general|Imperial Edict|Korriban}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
However, a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] found the edict in the tomb and was able to defeat a number of the raiders and bring the stolen artifacts to Rikel.<ref name="Imperial Edict" />
{{Endgame}}
